specification.mechanism: C_word[j]=P_word[j]+k_word mod29; a constant additive mask per word cancels from each c[j]-c[0]. Repeated plaintext words retain an ordered normalized fingerprint.
basis: reviews/auto-cycle-009.md H026 is proposed and untested
data/README.md identifies slash as image line metadata and ASCII whitespace as transcription formatting
specification.parser: Registered runes only 0..28; slash and ASCII space/newline/tab ignored as metadata, not a word split. Literal hyphen is a word boundary. Every other non-rune literal is a hard boundary. Page boundaries are hard. Preserve offsets of each block. Only length>=3 is scored. Unknown Unicode rune raises error. Grid literals are never mapped to runes.
specification.statistic: T=sum over (length, ordered tuple((x-x0) mod29)) groups of count*(count-1)/2. No word dictionary, key search, offset, length cap, alternate parser or language completion.
specification.controls: 99 independent random permutations within every scored word, preserving length and each word multiset; p=(1+controls>=T)/100. Ties counted conservatively.

gate.positive: Independent uniform mod29 additive key per word on contiguous verifier-only natural windows, preserving ordered words.
gate.negative: First50 cases independent uniform per-rune keys; remaining49 cases independent within-word permutation followed by a uniform additive key per word.
gate.windows: All original source words retained before length filter. For case i length=lengths[i%5], start=(i*7)%(source_word_count-length+1). Windows overlap and are not independent natural documents; report this limitation.
gate.synthetic_encoding: Existing synthetic.encode_text applied word by word; punctuation removed only in this explicitly synthetic protocol. This does not assert LP orthography.
gate.acceptance: At least18/20 positives have p<=0.01 and exactly0/99 negatives have p<=0.01; otherwise inconclusive and no LP2 worker dispatch.

specification.formal_screen_if_gate_passes: All55 rune-bearing LP2 pages; LP2/50 has no registered runes and is inapplicable. Identical word parsing. 99 whole-corpus controls preserve word and shared-page definitions. Per-page centered scaled maxT computed symmetrically from observed plus all99 controls; alpha0.01 is screening only. Also one predeclared global score=sum of within-page collisions, using same99 controls. Apply Bonferroni across two endpoints: per-page family/global alpha0.005; with99 controls minimum p0.01 means no confirmatory rejection is attainable, so any p<=0.01 is only unconfirmed exploratory lead. No significance/confirmation claim.
specification.independent_validation: Independent pairwise equality with constant-difference condition checks worker collision score on all observed jobs; exact known positive normalized fingerprints compare to verifier plaintext; independent parser fixture tests slash continuation and hard barriers; control scores checked by independent pairwise statistic on first two gate jobs.
specification.failure_scope: Gate failure concerns this word-collision measurement and the fixed short natural windows, not absence of a word mask in LP2. Screening failure only concerns this exact parser/statistic/controls; no exact plaintext recovered.
